ADA.name: Adam
ADA.bio: Has posted the lowest point totals the last few years yet somehow keeps dodging last place. Consistently one of the worst managers in the league — and never met a bad bet he didn't like.

CHR.name: Chris
CHR.bio: The 2022 champion and everyone's favorite to mess with. Sports a hairstyle best described as a bird's nest. Loves firing off ridiculous trade offers and is working with David Hurst to overthrow the commissioner.

DAV.name: David
DAV.bio: Back-to-back champion (2024 & 2025). Really smart, really talented — and, having already won it all, still leading a campaign to replace Commissioner Jason with Chris Dambro. A genuine threat, on the field and in the group chat.

DRE.name: Drew
DRE.bio: The 2021 champion and an absolute wildcard. No one knows quite what he's up to, but he somehow makes it to every sporting event across the country. Wild guy.

DYL.name: Dylan
DYL.bio: Finished last twice (2022 and 2024) and never fulfilled the punishment — so everyone still gives him shit about it. Rightfully so.

ERI.name: Erick
ERI.bio: The 2020 champion who got absolutely destroyed by injuries this year. Also loves to roast the commissioner at every opportunity.

HOA.name: Hoa
HOA.bio: Loves his kicker more than any man should. Reliably finishes middle of the pack, year after year — and is the only manager who has never finished last.

JAS.name: Jason
JAS.bio: The Commissioner. Everyone loves to hate on him. Has consistently finished near the top but has never won it outright — the streak lives on after a 3rd-place finish in 2025.

MAT.name: Matt
MAT.bio: 2023 champion. Lives out in California and is, by all accounts, a total badass.

TOL.name: Tola
TOL.bio: Has historically made some genuinely terrible picks but somehow does well anyway. Better than his draft board deserves — though the 2021 basement is still on his record.

WES.name: Wes
WES.bio: Pastor Reverend Wes — college pastor to many people in the league. Lives out in Texas and is the certified “dad” of the group. Finished last in 2025 at 4-10, losing the tiebreaker to Hoa on points — and therefore owes the league the 9/9/9 Challenge.

ZAC.name: Zack
ZAC.bio: Finished last in 2023 with a 1-13 campaign — the worst record in recorded league history. Extremely active in the shit-talk department and just trying, desperately, to stay out of the basement.

DAV.line: Has taken 34% of every dollar ever paid into this league. Nearly all of it in the last two years.

MAT.line: Made $560 in 2023 and $35 in every other season combined.

JAS.line: Cashed a check every year from 2021 to 2025. Still zero rings. The most profitable loser in league history.

ERI.line: Six seasons and a championship, and still $7 short of breaking even.

ZAC.line: The 2021 Sewp Revenge Tour paid $120. He's made $13 since.

DYL.note: 2024 includes $24.45 in HYSA interest, held by the treasury and released only after he completed his Costco punishment.
DYL.line: $24.45 of his lifetime earnings came from interest, paid only after he finished eating hot dogs inside a Costco.

WES.line: $24 lifetime. $4 a year. God does not reward this.
